note: Con ngua van bi co che o giua than khien panoptic tach lam hai segment, detection ve mot box bao tron la dung tu nhien.
Nguoi cuoi ngua bi than ngua va day cuong che khuat mot phan, panoptic tach manh chu khong phai thieu box hay lech nhan.
Cau thu bong chay bi nguoi bat bong dung che mot phan chan, panoptic chia hai manh tu nhien chu detection khong ve sai.
Trong anh la chiec xe dap dung canh tuong co ban dap va nan hoa, detection ghi nham thanh motorcycle.
Ghe bang dai bang go o san bong chay ngoai troi, detection ghi bench la dung, panoptic gan nham thanh couch.
Hai nua banh mi kep sandwich dat canh nhau tren dia, panoptic da gop chung ca hai mieng vao mot mat na segment duy nhat.
Nguoi truot tuyet dang mang doi van truot skis ro rang tren nen tuyet trang nhung detection hoan toan thieu bounding box.
Hai nguoi ngoi sat nhau tren ghe sofa trong phong khach, panoptic da gop hai ca nhan thanh mot segment mat na chung.
Bounding box detection quanh nguoi cuoi ngua bi ve lech tam sang mot ben lam ho phan than nguoi ra ngoai khung.
Hop bao detection quanh nguoi phu nu dung tai quay bep bi lech kich thuoc va vi tri so voi co the that cua nguoi trong anh.
